title: Grateful Dead Live at Central Park on 1969-06-22
lineage: AUD low gen (complete show) + SBD MC > C > D > CD

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience tape of a Central Park barn‑burner, highlighted by pedal‑steel fireworks on “Silver Threads & Golden Needles” and “Me and My Uncle.”
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) source with heavy hiss, mud and occasional crowd obscenities, but listeners note that the noise sits behind a surprisingly hot performance.  Fans rave about the pedal‑steel work and overall jam energy, calling the show a “barn‑burner,” even though the audio fidelity keeps it from being a clean listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised as energetic and memorable (high show weight), but recording quality is consistently described as poor/muddy, pulling the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Heavy hiss and mud, loud crowd obscenities; some reviewers say it sounds better from another room but overall clarity is low.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Free‑concert vibe with solid playing throughout; energetic jams and notable pedal‑steel moments keep the momentum high despite the rough recording.
